title: コモンズ・架空ブランドのボトルラベル
description: 架空の6ブランドのラベルを3列×2段にまとめたアトラス。UVで使うセルを指定。 ベースカラー画像のみ。Clampで使用。シームレス反復には対応しません。
descriptionEn: Six fictional bottle-label designs in a 3-column, 2-row atlas. Select cells with mesh UVs. Base color only. Use Clamp. This atlas does not support seamless tiling.
author: Xenoah

provenance.method: Original AI-generated cafe texture, copied byte-for-byte from its recorded source
provenance.rights: Xenoah original image. On 2026-10-14 the owner authorized its publication in the CC-BY-4.0 Meshcopia library. No third-party photograph or texture is included.
provenance.changes: Original PNG is unchanged. A separate resized WebP thumbnail and metadata were added. Original Clamp sampling is retained.
provenance.generationBrief: 3 by 2 square-cell atlas: ANCHOR reserve amber malt, ORBIT botanical gin, HORIZON citrus aperitif, RELAY dark rum, ARCHIVE dry vermouth, COMMONS zero-proof botanical. Etched vintage emblems; cream, green, orange, navy, burgundy, mint.

usage: Clampで使用。シームレス反復には対応しません。
usageEn: Use Clamp. This atlas does not support seamless tiling.

usages.context: Original world texture; no specific deployed scene usage asserted.
